name: Furnaces, smokers, blast furnaces and campfires
note: Furnaces, smokers and blast furnaces burn their fuel and cook by the official data packs' recipes (the first by the id's path, then its namespace), light and go out, fill and empty through hoppers by their faces and drive comparators, as both official servers do tick by tick; every item's burn time as both report it
deviations: an experience's rest below 1 comes by a random of Circuit's own, where the official servers draw from an unseeded random
several recipes give their experience in recipe id order, the official servers in a hash order
